_comment: Executable contract for the agent Plaud note — how an agent that carries the Plaud plugin refers to a recording, and what the app renders instead. The agent returns an IDENTIFIER (plaud://<file_id>); the app resolves it with its own Plaud grant into the usual chip and preview. Consumed by BOTH platforms' tests (Swift: scripts/PlaudNoteContractTest.swift via scripts/test-attach-note.sh; Kotlin: android app unit test AgentPlaudNoteTest). The reader is deliberately forgiving — the writer is a language model.
